text:
Nina: Heads-up: post-deploy we're seeing a small spike in fncall schema rejects on the `summarize-notes` route. Up ~2.8% vs baseline starting 02:12 UTC.
Eli: Are these parse errors or strict validator rejects?
Nina: Strict validator returning 422. Pattern: models returning `attachments: []` while schema expects object or null; some model decoders changed to emit empty arrays for missing attachments.
Ravi: That union mismatch again. We hit this in last week's adapter update. Do we have a quick fallback?
Leah: We can route the canary slice to permissive validator override while we investigate. Quick config change available.
Nina: Can we also sample rejects to help the model team debug? Need redaction.
ops-bot: Metric request: create `fncall.validation.sample_rejects` with default sample rate 1/200. Reply :white_check_mark: to confirm.
ops-bot: Metric `fncall.validation.sample_rejects` created and hooked to ingestion.
Eli: For billing clarity: are these counted as billable requests? Past confusion with customers.
Ravi: Yes — we bill on inference attempt. We should surface `validation.status` in API responses and Console so customers know.
Leah: I can mock a Console badge: "Validator: strict (canary: permissive)" and show "Sampled schema rejects: N (link)". design-bot: requesting mock slot.
design-bot: Mock claim submitted: https://intranet.redwood.design/mocks/validator-badge-summarize-notes
Nina: Proposed steps: 1) flip canary slice to permissive validator; 2) enable 1/200 sampled payload logging with PII redaction; 3) add API flag `x-validation-reason` and console note; 4) consider auto-backoff if rate >1% for 5m. Thoughts?
Eli: Sounds good. For (4) I'd make auto-backoff opt-in per rollout policy. We already have a rollout hook.
Ravi: Add `validation.scope` tag (model|adapter|runtime) to samples so triage is faster. Also include `validator_schema_sha` and `validator_version`.
Leah: UX: also add a tooltip: "Schema rejects are billed. To avoid surprises, preview strict validator in dev environment."
Nina: Small API detail: SDKs should expose `ValidationRejected` error code so apps can programmatically handle.
Eli: I'll wire the trace propagation tags and sampling_id. Also emit a counter `fncall.validation.reject_rate` for alerting.
ops-bot: Alert created: `fncall.validation.reject_rate > 0.01 for 5m (canary)` -> post to #release-war-room.
Ravi: Quick config example for routing override: \n```yaml\nroutes:\n  - id: summarize-notes\n    slice: canary\n    validator_mode: permissive\n```
Leah: Timeline: put permissive fallback live now, monitor 15m, then decide on schema patch vs model team fix. I'll update the Console mock after billing confers with docs.
Nina: I'll open the PR with routing change + sampling metric + API flag. Tagging @Eli @Leah.
Eli: After PR, I'll deploy the trace updates and add `validator_schema_sha` to the tags.
Ravi: One more: include `validation.failure_hint` in samples with limited enum values so we don't leak text. e.g., "empty-array-for-object".
Leah: Noted. Design will include a short explainer copy.
ops-bot: Deploy job 9345 started for routing change.
ops-bot: Deploy job 9345 succeeded in us-east-1.
Nina: Reject rate dropping back to baseline. Closing once stable for 30m. Thanks all.
Eli: Follow-up: SDK error code PR incoming.
Leah: I'll coordinate billing copy with Documentation.
Nina: End.
